text:
maria: heads-up — canary push for release v2.14.1 failed validation in us-west-2, deploybot blocked publish. see log snippet below.

ashok: ack. which check failed?

maria: cosign verify failed with KMS timestamp mismatch. deploybot says signature timestamp is ahead of key metadata TTL. not a full attestation rejection but deploybot refused to promote.

sam: paste the exact error?

maria: 
```
deploybot: publish failed: cosign: verification error: signature timestamp 2026-03-21T14:02:33Z > KMS key metadata expiry 2026-03-20T23:59:59Z
hint: key rotation observed in region us-west-2; manifest signing time outside allowed window
```

jen: ugh — that looks like a delayed signing job hitting a rotated key. did the CI runner sign in a different region?

maria: signing step ran in us-east-1, then image replicated to us-west-2. cosign signature embedded timestamp from east, deploybot verify ran in west against local KMS policy and failed TTL check.

ashok: options: 1) manual retag+resign in us-west-2, 2) pin canary back to previous digest and abort promotion, 3) relax deploybot verification window (not great).

sam: we should not relax checks during a release window. prefer pin back to previous digest for now and open a follow-up to standardize signing region or use cross-region KMS policy.

jen: agree. pin to digest sha256:8a7f... from last green canary. I'll update release notes and the canary route config.

maria: can deploybot do an automated rollback to the pinned digest or do we need manual?

deploybot: automated rollback supported for route canary->stable when explicit rollback flag provided. no automatic fallback for signature TTL mismatch. manual intervention needed to flip the target digest.

ashok: ok jen, please perform manual pinflip and comment with command you ran. include the new release note line: "canary held due to cross-region signing timestamp; pinned to previous digest while we remediate".

jen: will do. running: `rbctl promote --route canary --digest sha256:8a7f... --reason "timestamp mismatch - pinback"`

maria: once that's in, I'll trigger a canary smoke suite and watch observability for 15m. if anything else breaks, we escalate to a rollback across regions.

sam: open ticket ENG-5342 for remediation: "cross-region signing TTL - standardize signing region or adapt verification window". assign to infra-signing team. add postmortem checklist item.

ashok: also add a short-term runbook: if deploybot blocks on cosign timestamp, pinback to prev digest + attach signed manifest from local KMS and retest.

jen: pinflip done. `rbctl` output: success, route canary -> sha256:8a7f..., note attached.

maria: running canary smoke now.

deploybot: reaction :white_check_mark: — publish blocked messages archived under /releases/blocked/4523456789.log

sam: thx. everyone, please react with :eyes: after you verify logs. We'll keep the change window open until remediation and update release notes before any new promotion.

ashok: noted. follow-up: coordinate with CI to sign in target region or use KMS key aliases with consistent TTL checks. scheduling infra patch next week.

jen: added release note line and PR link in the ticket.

maria: confirmed smoke green for current pinned canary. holding promotion. closing here but keeping ticket active. :thumbsup:
